# SeekerClaw

> SeekerClaw is AgentOS for your Android phone. It turns your phone into a 24/7 helper powered by the world's best AI — Claude, GPT, and more. Text it on Telegram or Discord: it thinks, remembers, watches over your stuff, and quietly handles the boring parts of your day.

SeekerClaw is a native Android app (Solana Seeker-optimized, runs on any Android 14+). It brings a full AI agent on-device: 56+ built-in tools, 35+ skills, persistent memory, and natural-language scheduling. Users chat with it through Telegram or Discord; the agent runs autonomously in the background 24/7. The agent scores 100% on SAB (Self-Awareness Benchmark) — it knows its own tools, diagnoses its own problems, and reports failures in plain English. Crypto is one capability among many: wallet, swaps, limit orders, and NFT tracking via Solana's Seed Vault — not the identity of the product.

- Operating system: Android 14+ (made for Solana Seeker; works on any Android phone)
- AI providers: Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI / GPT-5, 100+ models via OpenRouter (user provides their own API key, stored locally)
- Chat interfaces: Telegram and Discord (user provides their own bot token)
- Phone powers: GPS, camera, SMS, calls, contacts, apps, clipboard, text-to-speech
- Web: search, page reading, research, news, weather, crypto prices
- Skills system: 35+ built-in skills plus a Skill Creator for custom ones (no coding required)
- Crypto (optional): Solana wallet hardware-secured via Seed Vault; swaps, DCA, limit orders, NFT tracking
- Self-awareness: 100% SAB score (36/36 audit points) — no hallucinated features, no silent failures
- Privacy: No analytics, no tracking, no cloud servers, all data on-device. Open-source under MIT License.
- Recognition: Winner of the Solana Mobile Hackathon; live on Product Hunt.

## Pages

- [Home](https://seekerclaw.xyz/): Main landing page — hero, how it works, lifestyle scenarios, features, self-awareness, use cases, Seeker hardware, comparison vs regular AI services, vision
- [Quick Setup](https://seekerclaw.xyz/setup.html): Generate a config QR code to import credentials and defaults into SeekerClaw in under a minute
- [Skill Creator](https://seekerclaw.xyz/skill-creator.html): Interactive 3-mode tool to build custom skills (blank editor, templates, Claude prompt generator)
- [Partner Skills](https://seekerclaw.xyz/partner-skills.html): Vetted integrations that extend the agent — ClawPump, Dune Analytics, Byreal DEX, Home Assistant, Career Companion
- [Privacy Policy](https://seekerclaw.xyz/privacy.html): Privacy policy — no data collection, no tracking, all on-device
- [Terms of Use](https://seekerclaw.xyz/terms.html): End-user Terms of Use — usage terms, risk disclosures, and liability for the app and its autonomous agent
